declaredBefore: any S11B run on a real cartridge

seriesA_continuousHold.limitsNote: agod-causal.js defaults maxFramesPerArm=120 with a hard CAP of 600; horizons 240 and 480 pass explicit limits in an isolated experiment. Production limits unchanged.

seriesB_pulseTrain.sampling: RAM after every complete hold+release cycle
seriesB_pulseTrain.adapterNote: Causal.probeAction holds one mask for the whole window and cannot express a pulse train. Passing 720 as frames is forbidden: it would substitute the action structure and exceed the hard per-arm limit of 600. A separate experimental adapter implements the train with the same neutral, alternative and independent-start principles; the standard detector's rules are unchanged.

outcomeRule: these must never be merged under CAUSAL_RECOVERED, and none of them is evidence that a game resource is useless
startStateRules: the same pre-declared start states for every horizon and mask
the start procedure is not changed after a result is seen
a trajectory attested NOT-REACHED or UNCONFIRMED stays diagnostic and does not enter comparability statistics
an identical state hash is not an independent history; HOLDOUT keeps actual independence from the selection procedure

budget.stoppingRule: exhausting the total frame limit yields BUDGET_EXCEEDED; exhaustion inside a candidate marks that candidate BUDGET_EXCEEDED and later candidates are not evaluated

headlineQuestions.A: how many candidates went undetected because of the short horizon
headlineQuestions.B: how many candidates went undetected because of the wrong action structure
headlineQuestions.C: how many changes stay irreproducible or are explained by time, game phase or another mechanism

successRule: more observed RAM changes is not success; the result must show an independent difference between the action and the neutral course of the game. VERIFIED_GOAL is not a goal of this stage.
unchanged: the S11A two-transition rule stays OFF and is not retuned
PRE_AND_POST is not enabled by default
